Company Introduction:
Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.
Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Oversea” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.
We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”
Role Overview:
We are seeking an exceptionally pragmatic and results-driven Lead Data Analyst to be the strategic core of our Supply Chain team. Your mission is to solve our toughest demand forecasting and inventory challenges—from preventing stockouts to clearing excess goods. This is not a back-office reporting role. You will be a hands-on catalyst who can "figure things out," develop clever solutions, and collaborate across the company to see your insights implemented in our production systems.
What You Will Do:
Ideate & Develop Smart Heuristics:
Proactively identify weaknesses in our supply chain systems and develop smart, practical logic from solving them. Your focus will be on driving demand forecast improvements, Out-of-Stock (OOS) and excess inventory attribution models.
Build Rapid Proof-of-Concepts (POCs):
Quickly validate your ideas with hands-on POCs. You will build working prototypes, such as a Root Cause Analysis dashboard that automatically attributes OOS events to causes like 'Under-forecasting'.
Product Analytics:
Participate in experimentation design, A/B tests, cohort studies and measuring the effectiveness of product launches.
AI & prompt Engineering:
Leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and advanced prompt engineering to automate unstructured data, and accelerate internal analytical workflows.
Champion for Productionalization:
Partner closely with our Demand Planning and Engineering teams to get your validated POCs productionalized. You are the subjectmatter expert who ensures your logic is accurately integrated into our core inventory planning systems.
Become the GoTo Expert:
Own the analytics around our key supply chain KPIs, including demand forecast accuracy, Sell- through and forecast coverage. You will not just report on these numbers; you will provide the "why" behind them.
Act as a Data Translator:
Proactively communicate with technical and nontechnical partners, ensuring stakeholders understand not just the 'what' but the 'so what' of your findings. You are the bridge that turns complex analysis into clear business directives.
Basic Qualifications
Experience:
8+ years of relevant working experience in a data analytics or business intelligence role.
Technical Stack:
Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python/R for data extraction and manipulation.
AI Proficiency:
Practical experience with prompt engineering and using generative AI tools to solve data problems or automate content generation.
Visualization:
Mastery of data storytelling using PowerBI, Tableau, or similar tools to communicate insights effectively to non-experts.
Communication:
Business-level fluency in English with a proven ability to teach and onboard non-technical business users.
Preferred Qualifications:
Data Engineering:
Hands-on experience with version control (GitHub) and workflow orchestration tools like Airflow.
C
ontent & Documentation:
Experience managing internal wikis (e.g., Confluence, Notion) or building structured knowledge bases for large organizations.
Domain Expertise:
Previous experience in Retail, E-commerce and Demand Forecasting.
Quantitative Depth:
Strong knowledge of statistics and ML techniques (e.g., elasticity modeling, clustering for customer segmentation).

회사 소개
Coupang Fulfillment Services(이하 CFS)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS는 물류센터(Fulfillment Center, 이하 FC) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 이커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
Fulfillment Center(이하 FC)는 쿠팡의 물류센터를 말하는 것으로 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고를 담당하는 곳입니다. FC는 단순한 물류 창고가 아닌, 첨단 기술이 집약된 하나의 Automation Factory로서, 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화 하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.

• 물류센터 담당 공정의 일일 운영 관리 및 현장 오퍼레이션 관리

Role Overview
Coupang’s Cyber Threat Intelligence team is part of GHOST within Proactive Security under the Digital Trust organization. GHOST stands for Global Hunting, Oversight, and Strategic Triage. The organization proactively identifies and analyzes cyber threats that may affect Coupang and turns its findings into meaningful security actions.
The Cyber Threat Intelligence team collects and analyzes information from a wide range of sources, including open sources, commercial intelligence services, the dark web, and security telemetry. The team tracks threat actors and campaigns and identifies and responds to threats that may affect Coupang, including phishing, fraud, brand and executive impersonation, exposed data and credentials, malicious infrastructure, and high-risk vulnerabilities.
This position will primarily focus on intelligence activities that protect Coupang executives. You will continuously monitor digital exposure, impersonation, personal information exposure, phishing, social engineering, and other online threats affecting executives. You will turn analytical findings into actionable intelligence that supports timely protective measures and informed decision-making.
The focus of this position is intelligence-led executive protection rather than physical close protection. However, because information discovered in the digital environment may indicate potential risks to physical safety, you will work closely with Corporate Security, Legal, Privacy, Investigations, and other relevant teams.
Executive protection will be the primary focus of this position. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s expertise, the role may also contribute to other Cyber Threat Intelligence responsibilities, including Fraud Intelligence, Digital Risk Protection, and third-party and supply chain threat intelligence.
This position is being hired at the Staff level and requires at least eight years of professional experience in a relevant security field. We are looking for someone who can independently lead significant and sensitive threat investigations, coordinate response and program improvements across organizations, and translate intelligence into executive decisions and meaningful protective actions.
What You Will Do
Executive Digital Exposure Monitoring:
Monitor executive-related digital exposure across authorized sources, including the open web, social media, professional networking platforms, data leak sites, the deep web, and the dark web. Distinguish legitimate online activity from potential risk and identify exposures that require further action.
Executive Impersonation Detection and Response:
Detect and analyze social media and professional networking profiles, email accounts, domains, websites, messages, images, audio, video, and other synthetic media that impersonate executives. Assess the intent and potential impact of the impersonation and coordinate blocking, notification, takedown, and follow-up actions with relevant teams.
Personal Information and Credential Exposure Response:
Monitor for external exposure of sensitive executive information, including contact details, addresses, account information, credentials, schedules, or location-related information. Assess the accuracy and risk of exposed information and work with relevant teams and external service providers to support removal, takedown, account protection, and other protective actions.
Protective Intelligence and Threat Assessment:
Investigate phishing, social engineering, Business Email Compromise, malicious disclosure of personal information, harassment, threatening references, and indicators of cyber or physical targeting involving executives. Assess source credibility, threat actor intent and capability, likelihood, and potential impact, and recommend an appropriate response or escalation level.
Response Coordination and Case Management:
When an executive-related threat is identified, promptly share intelligence and coordinate response activities with Corporate Security, Legal, Privacy, Investigations, Incident Response, and other relevant teams. Document investigative evidence and response actions and track progress and residual risk until the case is closed.
Executive CTI Reporting:
Provide executives and relevant leadership with clear and concise reports and briefings on their individual threat environment, significant cyber threats, impersonation and personal information exposure, and risks requiring immediate attention. Communicate complex threat information in a form that non-technical audiences can understand and act upon.
Travel and Geopolitical Intelligence Support:
As needed, analyze geopolitical conditions, civil unrest, crime, terrorism, cyber threats, and other security risks related to executive travel or major events and provide relevant teams with intelligence briefings.
Support for Adjacent CTI Responsibilities:
Based on team priorities and operational needs, support other Cyber Threat Intelligence activities such as Fraud Intelligence, Digital Risk Protection, third-party and supply chain threat intelligence, phishing and brand protection, and data exposure investigations.
Tools, Automation, and AI:
Use CTI and Executive Protection platforms, search tools, data analysis technologies, and AI-powered tools to improve the efficiency and accuracy of monitoring, classification, enrichment, investigation, and reporting. Validate AI-generated outputs against original sources and additional investigation.
Global Collaboration:
Work effectively with security teams, executive support organizations, engineering teams, business stakeholders, external CTI providers, and takedown service providers across the United States, Korea, and other regions to mitigate threats affecting executives and Coupang.
